summary: Protected B2 source integrates the shared WASM supervisor into production preview/live Client and the existing facade. Receiver scripts carry the adapter index, generated Fable modules and complete installed Worker assets, with explicit v4 live pins and exact archive/source/hash checks. The source guard preserves all copied files, including dormant Node-only library modules, but validates imports reached from explicit host, adapter and Worker entrypoints. Its restricted lexical subset rejects nonliteral/escaped imports and ambiguous forms; it is not a full JavaScript parser or browser proof. The source-delivered closure and the historical B1 qualification remain separate from actual B2 bundled browser, installed-receiver and native acceptance. Legacy assets are retained; this is no .7 removal decision.
title: Shared Worker deployment needs both complete inventory and reachable imports
